title: Fuel-system specifications
introduction:
I match the engine named in this section to its table row before reading a value. Engine labels work like keys: almost matching still leaves you at the wrong door. The table includes other engines for comparison, so its placement in this section does not make every row applicable.

The pressure entries apply with the engine running. The turbocharged engine's entry is specifically for the low-pressure side. Read each range with its paired pressure units, and keep those operating conditions attached to the number. Tank capacity describes how much fuel the tank holds; it does not establish delivery pressure or injector operation.

Use this page to look up specifications. A pressure measurement needs the matching engine's test setup, equipment and connection instructions. Before opening fuel plumbing, use the applicable safety and pressure-release procedures; switching the engine off alone does not establish that pressure is gone.

edits.why: Select the engine-specific row within the relevant category. Running pressure and tank capacity answer different questions, and the low-pressure-side qualifier limits where its pressure range applies. This table supplies reference values rather than a pressure-test sequence or a repair decision.
